introPt: A traveller asks instead of ranking.
cenario: A conversation about the capital and everywhere else.

dialogo.es: 東京は日本じゃないですよ。それは覚えといたほうがいい。
dialogo.pt: Tokyo isn't Japan. You should know that.
dialogo.tts: 東京は日本じゃないですよ。それは覚えといたほうがいい。

dialogo.es: 私？二十歳で上京して、四十で地元に戻ってきました。
dialogo.pt: Me? I went up to Tokyo at twenty. I came back home at forty.
dialogo.tts: 私？二十歳で上京して、四十で地元に戻ってきました。

dialogo.es: まだよく知らないので、何とも言えません。
dialogo.pt: I don't know enough yet to say.
dialogo.tts: まだよく知らないので、何とも言えません。

dialogo.es: ここでは、とてもよくしてもらいました。
dialogo.pt: Here, I've been treated very well.
dialogo.tts: ここでは、とてもよくしてもらいました。

perguntas.pergunta: The concentration of people and jobs in Tokyo (東京一極集中) is:
opcoes: A local complaint with nothing behind it
Documented — a large share of population and economy, targeted by a 2014 law
A recent invention of the media
Unmeasured folklore
perguntas.explica: The greater Tokyo area holds a very large share of the country; the 2014 まち・ひと・しごと創生法 was written to counter it.

perguntas.pergunta: «Joukyou shite, jimoto ni modotte kita» is usually:
opcoes: A party political position
A family and working history
A joke
A geography lesson
perguntas.explica: The verbs carry a career, a rent and a return far more often than a policy view.

perguntas.pergunta: The move that ends the conversation is:
opcoes: Asking what has changed here
Ranking the capital against the rest of the country
Saying you don't know enough
Saying you were well received here
perguntas.explica: A verdict from a guest costs you the rest of the evening.

perguntas.pergunta: «Mada yoku shiranai node, nantomo iemasen» is heard as:
opcoes: Evasion
Good sense, and an accurate answer
Rudeness
Agreement with them
perguntas.explica: After three weeks in a country it is simply true, and it reads as good sense.

perguntas.pergunta: Which one is always safe to say?
opcoes: The regions are friendlier than Tokyo
Tokyo works better than anywhere else
Here, I've been treated very well
Neither half of the country works
perguntas.explica: Experience is allowed anywhere; comparison is the part that costs.
